scripts.precmx:compile: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const dir of ['.cmx/bundle', '.cmx/documents']) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.cmx:build: npm run cmx:compile && npm run cmx:render && npm run cmx:environment && node scripts/build-routes.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.content:build: npm run cmx:build && npm run media:build && node scripts/build-publication.ts
scripts.test:website: node --import remix/node-tsx --test tests/newsletter.test.ts tests/newsletter-worker.test.ts tests/publication-worker.test.ts && playwright test --config playwright.website.config.ts
scripts.check:website: prettier app scripts/build.ts scripts/build-dev.ts scripts/check-content-host.ts playwright*.config.ts tests/website.spec.ts tests/host-fixture.ts tests/publication-worker.test.ts tests/newsletter*.ts cmx.config.ts tsconfig.website.json package.json wrangler.jsonc .github/workflows/deploy.yml --check && npm run typecheck:website && npm run test:website
